title: Web Publication of Local Assembly Minutes in Tokachi, Hokkaido, and Regional Issues

model.params_source: assumed (Sec. 3.3 names only the model: 「使用した LLM は OpenAI API（モデル: gpt-4o-2024-05-13）である」)

task.subset_rule: the 198 utterance sentences containing the common feature word 国立公園 / 国立公園化 (Sec. 3.3)
task.approximation: cannot be fixed: item set, human gold labels and prompt wording are all unavailable (see open_points)

items.source: PDF assembly minutes published on the websites of 14 Tokachi (Hokkaido) municipalities for Reiwa 1-5, text-extracted with pdfminer.six (-L option), split at 。, then filtered to the sentences containing the TF-IDF feature word 国立公園 (Sec. 2.3 / 3.2 / 3.3)

fields.label: human label, one of the 15 categories of Table 2

items.license: the minutes are public municipal records; the article itself is CC BY 4.0
items.no_release: The paper links no repository or data archive; the 198 sentences and their manual labels are published nowhere.

prompt.verbatim: none. The paper states only 「ラベル名は，表 2 に記載されている 15 ラベルをプロンプトにて指定し」(the 15 labels of Table 2 were specified in the prompt) and that each input was a single sentence split at 。. No prompt text, no output format and no system message are printed.

output.postprocess: unknown: the paper does not state the output format; the Table 2 LLM column sums to 194 over 198 sentences, which suggests one label per sentence with a few empty answers

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: per-label F1 = 2PR/(P+R) with recall = matches / human count and precision = matches / LLM count, computed per category as in Table 2
metric.original_location: Table 2, row 自然環境保護 (human 10, LLM 11, matches 8, R 0.800, P 0.727, F1 0.762)

cost.est_note: hand estimate: 594 calls on gpt-4o-2024-05-13, one short Japanese sentence plus the 15 label names per call. No prepare run: the items do not exist publicly.

open_points: No item source. The 198 sentences are the output of a pipeline the paper describes but does not publish (pdfminer.six extraction from each municipality's PDF minutes, sentence splitting at 。, TF-IDF feature-word selection). The municipalities are named, but the minutes files, the extracted sentences and the 198-sentence selection are not released.
No gold labels. The manual labels Table 2 scores against are not published.
No prompt. Only the fact that the 15 category names were placed in the prompt is stated; the instruction text, the output format and whether a sentence may carry several labels are unknown.
Fragile cell. Per-category F1 in Table 2 ranges from 0.000 to 0.889 on counts as small as 1-4 items; the chosen 0.762 rests on 8 matches against 10 human and 11 LLM labels.
notes: Four-page Japanese short note (知能と情報 Vol.37 No.1, 2025). The cell is a genuine capability number for gpt-4o-2024-05-13 as a Japanese classifier, but nothing needed to run it is public.
